ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels across ~90% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized in small specks and streaks providing high macro-level contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Fine white mottling and specks are localized primarily on the posterior half and distal tips of both lobes; the central region near the fluke base maintains solid low-intensity dark pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped indentation with an estimated angle of 130-140 degrees; shallow depth relative to the overall horizontal span of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous sequence of irregular, high-frequency serrations; significant jagged peaks are visible on the outer third of the right lobe trailing edge, while the left lobe displays more uniform, lower-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge trajectory tapering into sharp, narrow lateral tips; trailing edge follows a slightly sigmoid curve from tip to notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized circular white pixel clusters (1-4px in diameter) distributed across the ventral surface of both lobes, particularly prominent on the mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct vertical white linear mark (rake mark) is visible on the inner portion of the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical linear white scar on the right lobe surface; distinct irregular indentation/notch on the distal trailing edge of the left lobe.
